verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל־ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הָֽאֲרָזִ֔ים וַאֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת יְרִיעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer yā·šaḇ dā·wîḏ bə·ḇê·ṯōw way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ ’el- nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḇêṯ hā·’ă·rā·zîm wa·’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ta·ḥaṯ yə·rî·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: After David had settled into his palace he said to Nathan the prophet Here I am living in a house of cedar while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent
verses.literalPt: Habitando Davi em sua casa, disse ao profeta Natã: Eis que habito eu numa casa de cedro, mas a arca da Aliança de Jeová está debaixo de cortinas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔יד כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nā·ṯān ’el- dā·wîḏ kōl ’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ‘ă·śêh kî hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: And Nathan . . . replied to David Do all that is in your heart for God is with you
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Natã a Davi: Faze tudo o que tens no teu coração, porque Deus é contigo.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֖י בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֑וּא וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל־ נָתָ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bal·lay·lāh ha·hū way·hî də·ḇar- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- nā·ṯān lê·mōr
verses.literal: But that . . . night the word of God came to Nathan saying
verses.literalPt: Na mesma noite, veio a palavra de Deus a Natã, dizendo:

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֣יד עַבְדִּ֔י כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א אַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה־ לִּ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- dā·wîḏ ‘aḇ·dî kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lō ’at·tāh tiḇ·neh- lî hab·ba·yiṯ lā·šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: Go and tell . . . My servant David that this is what the LORD says You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell
verses.literalPt: Vai e fala a Davi, meu servo: Assim diz Jeová: Tu não me edificarás casa para eu habitar;

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ בְּבַ֔יִת מִן־ הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶעֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָֽאֶהְיֶ֛ה מֵאֹ֥הֶל אֶל־ אֹ֖הֶל וּמִמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·šaḇ·tî bə·ḇa·yiṯ min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lê·ṯî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wā·’eh·yeh mê·’ō·hel ’el- ’ō·hel ū·mim·miš·kān
verses.literal: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt until this day but I have moved from tent to tent and dwelling to dwelling
verses.literalPt: não tenho habitado numa casa desde o dia em que fiz subir Israel até o dia de hoje, mas tenho mudado de uma tenda para outra tenda e de um tabernáculo para outro.

verses.original: בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־ הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲדָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת־ אַחַד֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתִי לִרְע֥וֹת אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֛מָּה לֹא־ בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî bə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl hă·ḏā·ḇār dib·bar·tî ’eṯ- ’a·ḥaḏ šō·p̄ə·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî lir·‘ō·wṯ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî lê·mōr lām·māh lō- ḇə·nî·ṯem lî bêṯ ’ă·rā·zîm
verses.literal: In all My journeys with all the Israelites have I ever asked . . . . . . any of the leaders . . . I appointed to shepherd My people Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar
verses.literalPt: Em todos os lugares em que tenho andado com Israel, falei eu jamais uma palavra a um dos juízes de Israel, a quem mandei que apascentassem o meu povo, dizendo: Por que não me tendes edificado uma casa de cedro?

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּה כֹּֽה־ תֹאמַ֞ר לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְדָוִ֗ידס כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הַנָּוֶ֔ה מִֽן־ אַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן לִהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kōh- ṯō·mar lə·‘aḇ·dî lə·ḏå̄·wī·ḏs kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·nî lə·qaḥ·tî·ḵā min- han·nā·weh min- ’a·ḥă·rê haṣ·ṣōn lih·yō·wṯ nā·ḡîḏ ‘al ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now then you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says I took you from the pasture from following the flock to be the ruler over My people Israel
verses.literalPt: Agora, assim dirás ao meu servo Davi: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos: Eu te tirei do curral, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses príncipe sobre o meu povo de Israel;

verses.original: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָאַכְרִ֥ית אֶת־ כָּל־ אוֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתִֽי לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֔ם כְּשֵׁ֥ם הַגְּדוֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eh·yeh ‘im·mə·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·laḵ·tā wā·’aḵ·rîṯ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·wy·ḇe·ḵā mip·pā·ne·ḵā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·ḵā šêm kə·šêm hag·gə·ḏō·w·lîm ’ă·šer bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I have been with you wherever you have gone and I have cut off all your enemies from before you Now I will make for you a name like that of the greatest in the land
verses.literalPt: e estive contigo por onde quer que andavas, exterminei todos os teus inimigos da tua presença; e te farei um nome como o dos grandes da terra.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְעַמִּ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְלֹא־ יוֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵי־ עַוְלָה֙ לְבַלֹּת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî mā·qō·wm lə·‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl ū·nə·ṭa‘·tî·hū wə·šā·ḵan taḥ·tāw wə·lō yir·gaz ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō- yō·w·sî·p̄ū ḇə·nê- ‘aw·lāh lə·ḇal·lō·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer bā·ri·šō·w·nāh
verses.literal: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
verses.literalPt: Designarei um lugar para o meu povo de Israel e o plantarei, para que habite no seu lugar e nunca mais seja movido; nem os filhos da perversidade o assolarão, como no princípio

verses.original: וּלְמִיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִכְנַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־ כָּל־ אוֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וָאַגִּ֣ד לָ֔ךְ וּבַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה־ לְּךָ֥ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·mî·yā·mîm ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî šō·p̄ə·ṭîm ‘al- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wə·hiḵ·na‘·tî ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·wy·ḇe·ḵā wā·’ag·giḏ lāḵ ū·ḇa·yiṯ yiḇ·neh- lə·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel And I will subdue all your enemies Moreover , I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you
verses.literalPt: e como desde o dia em que dei juízes sobre o meu povo de Israel; e subjugarei todos os teus inimigos. Também te declaro que Jeová te edificará casa.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ מָלְא֤וּ יָמֶ֙יךָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִם־ אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲקִֽימוֹתִ֤י אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה מִבָּנֶ֑יךָ וַהֲכִינוֹתִ֖י אֶת־ מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- mā·lə·’ū yā·me·ḵā lā·le·ḵeṯ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wa·hă·qî·mō·w·ṯî ’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā ’ă·šer yih·yeh mib·bā·ne·ḵā wa·hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî ’eṯ- mal·ḵū·ṯōw
verses.literal: And when your days are fulfilled and you go to be with your fathers I will raise up your descendant after you - one of your own sons and I will establish his kingdom
verses.literalPt: Quando forem cumpridos os dias de ires para teus pais, depois de ti, suscitarei a tua semente, um de teus filhos; e estabelecerei o seu reino.

verses.original: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה־ לִּ֖י בָּ֑יִת וְכֹנַנְתִּ֥י אֶת־ כִּסְא֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hū yiḇ·neh- lî bā·yiṯ wə·ḵō·nan·tî ’eṯ- kis·’ōw ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He will build a house for Me and I will establish his throne forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Esse me edificará casa, e estabelecerei o seu trono para sempre.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶה־ לּ֣וֹ לְאָ֔ב וְה֖וּא יִֽהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י לְבֵ֑ן וְחַסְדִּי֙ לֹא־ אָסִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲסִיר֔וֹתִי מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’eh·yeh- lōw lə·’āḇ wə·hū yih·yeh- lî lə·ḇên wə·ḥas·dî lō- ’ā·sîr mê·‘im·mōw ka·’ă·šer hă·sî·rō·w·ṯî mê·’ă·šer hā·yāh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: I will be his Father and he will be My son And I will never remove My loving devotion from him as I removed it from your predecessor . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Eu lhe serei por pai, e ele me será por filho; não tirarei dele a minha misericórdia, como a tirei do teu predecessor,

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתִּ֛יהוּ בְּבֵיתִ֥י וּבְמַלְכוּתִ֖י עַד־ הָעוֹלָ֑ם וְכִסְא֕וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·maḏ·tî·hū bə·ḇê·ṯî ū·ḇə·mal·ḵū·ṯî ‘aḏ- hā·‘ō·w·lām wə·ḵis·’ōw yih·yeh nā·ḵō·wn ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever . . . and his throne will be established forever . . .
verses.literalPt: mas o confirmarei na minha casa e no meu reino para sempre; o seu reino será para sempre estabelecido.

verses.original: כְּכֹל֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּכְכֹ֖ל הֶחָז֣וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל־ דָּוִֽיד׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵōl had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ū·ḵə·ḵōl he·ḥā·zō·wn haz·zeh kên dib·ber nā·ṯān ’el- dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation
verses.literalPt: Segundo todas essas palavras e segundo toda essa visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִֽי־ אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ וּמִ֣י בֵיתִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖נִי עַד־ הֲלֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ham·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ way·yê·šeḇ lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yō·mer mî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mî ḇê·ṯî kî hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯa·nî ‘aḏ- hă·lōm
verses.literal: Then King David went in sat before the LORD and said Who am I O LORD God and what is my house that You have brought me this far
verses.literalPt: Então, entrou o rei Davi, e se assentou diante de Jeová, e disse: Quem sou eu, Deus Jeová, e que é a minha casa, para que me tenhas trazido até aqui?

verses.original: וַתִּקְטַ֨ן זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר עַל־ בֵּֽית־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּרְאִיתַ֗נִי כְּת֧וֹר הָאָדָ֛ם הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ṭan zōṯ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ‘al- bêṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·mê·rā·ḥō·wq ū·rə·’î·ṯa·nî kə·ṯō·wr hā·’ā·ḏām ham·ma·‘ă·lāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes O God You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man . . . of great distinction O LORD God
verses.literalPt: Isso pareceu pouco aos teus olhos, ó Deus; porém falaste da casa do teu servo para um futuro ainda distante e me trataste como a um homem ilustre, ó Deus Jeová.

verses.original: מַה־ יּוֹסִ֨יף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛יד אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְכָב֣וֹד אֶת־ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֥ יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- yō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ dā·wîḏ ’ê·le·ḵā lə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā wə·’at·tāh ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: What more . . . can David say to You for honoring Your servant For You know Your servant
verses.literalPt: Que mais te pode dizer ainda Davi no tocante à honra feita ao teu servo? Pois tu conheces o teu servo.

verses.original: יְהוָ֕ה בַּעֲב֤וּר עַבְדְּךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגְּדֻלּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ba·‘ă·ḇūr ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ū·ḵə·lib·bə·ḵā ‘ā·śî·ṯā ’êṯ kāl- hag·gə·ḏūl·lāh haz·zōṯ lə·hō·ḏî·a‘ ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gə·ḏul·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: O LORD For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart You have accomplished this great thing and made known all these great promises
verses.literalPt: Jeová, por amor do teu servo e conforme o teu coração, fizeste todas essas grandes coisas, para as revelar .

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֔וֹךָ וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ên kā·mō·w·ḵā wə·’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm zū·lā·ṯe·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- šā·ma‘·nū bə·’ā·zə·nê·nū
verses.literal: O LORD there is none like You and there is no God but You according to everything we have heard with our own ears
verses.literalPt: Jeová, ninguém há semelhante a ti, nem há outro Deus fora de ti, segundo tudo o que temos ouvido com os nossos ouvidos.

verses.original: וּמִי֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לִפְדּ֧וֹת ל֣וֹ עָ֗ם לָשׂ֤וּם לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֚ם גְּדֻלּ֣וֹת וְנֹרָא֔וֹת לְגָרֵ֗שׁ מִפְּנֵ֧י עַמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר־ פָּדִ֥יתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî kə·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl gō·w ’e·ḥāḏ bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hā·laḵ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lip̄·dō·wṯ lōw ‘ām lā·śūm lə·ḵā šēm gə·ḏul·lō·wṯ wə·nō·rā·’ō·wṯ lə·ḡā·rêš mip·pə·nê ‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer- pā·ḏî·ṯā mim·miṣ·ra·yim gō·w·yim
verses.literal: And who is like Your people Israel the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself You made a name for Yourself through great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before Your people whom You redeemed from Egypt
verses.literalPt: Que outra nação na terra é como o teu povo de Israel, única a quem Deus foi remir para seu povo, a fim de te fazer um nome por meio de coisas grandes e terríveis, expulsando nações diante do teu povo que remiste do Egito?

verses.original: וַ֠תִּתֵּן אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל׀ לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·tên ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵā lə·‘ām ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh hā·yî·ṯā lā·hem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own . . . forever . . . and You O LORD have become their God
verses.literalPt: Pois fizeste o teu povo de Israel povo teu para sempre; e tu, Jeová, te fizeste seu Deus.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ יֵאָמֵ֖ן עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā ‘al- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā wə·‘al- bê·ṯōw yê·’ā·mên ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wa·‘ă·śêh ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā
verses.literal: And now O LORD let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant . . . and his house be established forever . . . Do as You have promised
verses.literalPt: Agora, Jeová, seja estabelecida para sempre a palavra que falaste a respeito do teu servo e a respeito da sua casa, e faze como falaste.

verses.original: וְ֠יֵֽאָמֵן וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד־ עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית־ דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדְּךָ֖ נָכ֥וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·’ā·mên wə·yiḡ·dal šim·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām lê·mōr Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇêṯ- dā·wîḏ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā nā·ḵō·wn lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever . . . when it is said The LORD of Hosts the God of Israel is God over Israel And may the house of Your servant David be established before You
verses.literalPt: Que ela seja estabelecida, e seja magnificado para sempre o teu nome, em dizer-se: Jeová dos Exércitos é Deus de Israel, sim, Deus para Israel; diante de ti está estabelecida a casa do teu servo Davi.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י גָּלִ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ אֹ֣זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת עַל־ כֵּן֙ מָצָ֣א עַבְדְּךָ֔ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hay gā·lî·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ō·zen ‘aḇ·də·ḵā liḇ·nō·wṯ lōw bā·yiṯ ‘al- kên mā·ṣā ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·hiṯ·pal·lêl lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: For You my God have revealed - to Your servant that You will build a house for him . . . Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You
verses.literalPt: Tu, Deus meu, revelaste ao teu servo que lhe edificarás casa; portanto, o teu servo achou confiança para orar diante de ti.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אַתָּה־ ה֖וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ עַֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֔ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’at·tāh- hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ‘al- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: And now O LORD You are God And You have promised this goodness to Your servant
verses.literalPt: Agora, Jeová, tu és Deus e prometeste este bem ao teu servo;

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאַ֙לְתָּ֙ לְבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּמְבֹרָ֖ךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hō·w·’al·tā lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- bêṯ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lih·yō·wṯ lə·‘ō·w·lām lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh bê·raḵ·tā ū·mə·ḇō·rāḵ lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant that it may continue forever before You For You O LORD have blessed it and it will be blessed forever
verses.literalPt: e, agora, te foste servido abençoar a casa do teu servo, para que permaneça para sempre diante de ti; porque tu, Jeová, abençoaste, ela está abençoada para sempre.
